title: Canon of the Hatchet Against Riders
summary: Teaches how to hook, cut and unseat mounted opponents with the light axe and how to break a charge.

title: Treatise of the Flight-Qi Axe
summary: Teaches steering a thrown axe in flight with a trailing thread of qi, including curving and second-pass throws.

title: Treatise on the Hatchet Against Armor
summary: Sets out how to read armor, strike its seams and rings, and throw into its gaps.

title: Course on Volleys of Many Hatchets
summary: Trains a field-circulating cultivator to carry, count and throw many axes in rolling volleys and chained pursuit.

title: Twin-Court Hatchet Doctrine
summary: Teaches the court's paired-axe guard, crossing throws and the cut-and-throw sequence along two tracks.

title: Azure Hawk Stoop Canon of the Hatchet
summary: Teaches the diving hawk-stoop throws and landing cuts of the azure school to a Demigod with sovereignty.

title: Paired River Axes Treatise
summary: Teaches flowing two-axe cuts, circling catches and confluent strikes in the manner of the river court.

title: Wind-Sworn Hatchet Canon
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn way of cutting and throwing on a held bearing, using gusts and open ground.

title: Plateau Oath Treatise on the Thrown Axe
summary: Passes on the plateau oath's sworn stance, rim throws and held-bearing barrage to a sovereign Demigod.

title: Bearing and Hatchet: A Plateau Course
summary: A short plateau course in fixing a bearing, striking along it and scattering throws across open ridges.
